name: Dicky
source:
"You think I'm cute? Well, thanks♪"

A young arsonist who finds peace in watching fires. Despite being in his late twenties, he looks youthful and is aware of his cuteness, often acting mischievously. He's a repeat offender who keeps getting jailed. His trademark is two red hairpins.
